subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Are the exact updated SHAs for actions that receive GitHub App keys, repository tokens, registry credentials, release artifacts, or agent API keys approved for OpenClaw's privileged workflows?
rationale: This is an upstream supply-chain acceptance decision for credential-bearing CI and release automation; repository source review can identify the boundary but cannot substitute for the owner's trust decision.

options.title: Approve the reviewed revision set
options.body: A workflow/security owner verifies the affected upstream revisions and accepts this grouped Dependabot update after redacted privileged-workflow evidence is available.

options.title: Split the sensitive actions
options.body: Keep routine setup and analysis action bumps separate, while reviewing token, Docker publish, attestation, and Codex-agent action revisions individually.

options.title: Pause this batch
options.body: Close or defer the grouped update if the exact upstream action revisions cannot be accepted for the credential-bearing workflows.

recommendation.title: Approve the reviewed revision set
recommendation.body: A workflow/security owner verifies the affected upstream revisions and accepts this grouped Dependabot update after redacted privileged-workflow evidence is available.
